Sonos Teardown

drumel microprobing Electronics Teardown PCB analysis audio system design

Wing Design CFD

Computational Fluid Dynamics 3D CAD Modelling Iterative Design Technical Troubleshooting Aerodynamic Analysis

In my final year of school, I entered a wing design competition run by Cambridge University Drone Society. After modelling my design in CAD, I optimised thelift to drag ratio with CFD by tracing air particles over the wing to identify flaws.
